messages.subject: Abhishek | GCC Executive Profile | Country Leadership, Government Relations & ESG
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Vats,

I am sharing my profile for senior GCC leadership mandates where country-facing execution, government relations, ESG, strategic partnerships and complex stakeholder management are central.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My portfolio spans government and regulatory relations, corporate and external affairs, ESG and social performance, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships, compliance coordination and executive communications. Earlier in my career I spent five years in regulated financial services with Scotiabank Guyana.

As Sheffield Haworth's Head of Middle East, your regional executive-search coverage is directly relevant to the cross-sector leadership mandates I am pursuing across Saudi Arabia, the UAE and the wider GCC.

I am targeting Director, Senior Director, Head, Country Director and VP-track roles across External Affairs, Government Relations, Corporate Affairs, ESG, Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships and Country Leadership.

I have attached my GCC-focused executive CV for confidential consideration. I am internationally mobile and available on 30 days' notice.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
